module_summary: Destination data side of a gray-code CDC FIFO: muxes the async storage array by read index and passes the word through a spill register to a valid/ready output.

anchors.name: dst_valid_i
anchors.why: Not-empty valid from the pointer logic into the spill register.

anchors.name: dst_ready_o
anchors.why: Spill register ready back to the pointer logic, advancing the read pointer.

anchors.name: dst_valid_o
anchors.why: Destination stream valid driven by the spill register.

anchors.name: dst_ready_i
anchors.why: Downstream ready popping words from the spill register.

anchors.name: dst_data_o
anchors.why: Registered FIFO word output from the spill register.

anchors.name: async_data_i
anchors.why: Asynchronous FIFO storage array from the source domain, read by index.

anchors.name: dst_ridx_i
anchors.why: Read index selecting the storage word from async_data_i.

anchors.name: dst_data
anchors.why: Muxed storage word feeding the spill register data input.

groups.name: storage_read_mux
groups.description: Indexes the async storage array with the read index.

groups.name: output_spill_register
groups.description: Spill register cutting valid/ready/data paths between FIFO read and output stream.
